resources.string: Use the phone as the TV\'s keyboard and mouse, without Wi-Fi
If the network drops, the remote reaches the TV over the phone\'s Bluetooth: keys, touchpad and keyboard.
Paired with the TV and connected
This phone doesn\'t let apps act as a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse.
Another app is using the phone as a Bluetooth keyboard. Close it, then try again.
tutti needs the Nearby devices permission
1. Tap Make visible.\n2. On the TV: Settings › Remotes & Accessories › Pair accessory, then choose tutti.\n3. Confirm the code on both: that\'s it.
Only one app at a time can be a Bluetooth keyboard. tutti takes the role only while it needs it and gives it back after.
Bluetooth sends key positions, not letters. Pick the layout set on the TV for this keyboard, or the letters come out wrong.
Can\'t type on this keyboard layout: %1$s
Which input is the computer on?
Plug the computer in or wake it: the input that comes on is selected.
Forget %1$s? Its settings on this phone are removed.
Bluetooth sends key positions, not letters: pick the layout set on the computer, or the letters come out wrong.
Its name, input and layout are removed from this phone. To unpair it fully, also remove the phone from the computer\'s Bluetooth settings.
A computer shown on the TV
A computer, the TV or the Theatre Bar
A Mac or a Windows or Linux PC, controlled from the remote while the TV shows it
Pair tutti with the BRAVIA over Wi-Fi
This phone can\'t act as a Bluetooth keyboard, so it can\'t control a computer.
Pair the computer with the phone

1. Tap Make visible: the phone shows up for 2 minutes.\n2. On the Mac: System Settings › Bluetooth, find this phone under Nearby Devices and click Connect.\n3. Check the code is the same on both, then confirm.

1. Tap Make visible: the phone shows up for 2 minutes.\n2. On Windows: Settings › Bluetooth & devices › Add device › Bluetooth, then choose this phone.\n3. Check the code is the same on both, then confirm.

1. Tap Make visible: the phone shows up for 2 minutes.\n2. On Linux: open the Bluetooth settings (GNOME: Settings › Bluetooth; KDE: System Settings › Bluetooth), choose this phone and pair.\n3. Check the code is the same on both, then confirm.
No paired computer yet. Once it has connected, it shows up here.
%1$s came on when you plugged in or woke the computer, so it\'s selected. Change it if that\'s wrong.
No input came on. Choose the one the computer is plugged into.
tutti can\'t see the TV\'s inputs without IP control. Leave it without an input for now: you can set it later from the computer\'s row.
This is how it shows on the remote.
When the TV shows %1$s, the remote controls %2$s. Its keyboard is set to %3$s: change it from its row if needed.
Choose it as the target on the remote to control it. Its keyboard is set to %1$s: change it from its row if needed.
Couldn\'t save the computer. Try again.
